disposition_reason: The CFIA 2022-23 targeted survey covered duck eggs, juices and nectars, dried mushrooms, spices, sugar and syrups (molasses), sweets and vinegars. Honey is not a product type, and the word 'honey' does not appear anywhere in the 11-page report.
disposition_locator: 'What we sampled', p.4 of 11 (text-copy lines 109-113) and Table 1 (product types, text-copy lines 128-139); grep -i honey on the full text copy returns 0 hits

study.design: targeted retail survey (not a total diet study)
study.material_scope: Duck eggs, juices/nectars, dried mushrooms, spices, sugar and syrups (molasses), sweets, vinegars. No honey.
study.growing_origin_vs_market: Retail in 11 Canadian cities. Domestic, imported and unspecified-origin products (Table 1).

contradictions_with_stored_summary: The wiki page lists '[[products/honey]]' in its products front matter, but the primary report has no honey samples or results. The 'sugar and syrups' category (n=67) is defined as molasses (p.4) and should not be routed to honey.
